definitions.gloss: eating until about 80 percent full; eating in moderation
definitions.explanation: The practice of stopping eating before feeling completely full, regarded as good for health. Also said as {腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}.

examples.japanese: {腹八分|はらはちぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧おく。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹八分|はらはちぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor advised me to eat in moderation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧「{腹八分|はらはちぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦いら→いる：00495_iru⟧ず」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Since old times it has been said that eating to 80 percent keeps the doctor away.

notes:
Often expanded to ⟦{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}→腹八分目：08318_harahachibunme⟧. Expresses the traditional idea that stopping before one is full is good for health and longevity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腹八分|はらはちぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦いら→いる：00495_iru⟧ず: eating to 80 percent keeps the doctor away (proverb)
- ⟦{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}→腹八分目：08318_harahachibunme⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eat to about 80 percent full
